items.t: SiriusXM to Present at the 2026 Wells Fargo 10th Annual TMT Summit
items.sum: SiriusXM (NASDAQ: SIRI) announced Zac Coughlin, Chief Financial Officer, will present on Monday, December 7, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. PT at the 2026 Wells Fargo 10th Annual TMT Summit in Rancho Palos Verdes, California. A webcast of the presentation will be available on the SiriusXM Investor Relations website at https://investor.siriusxm.com.
